title: Telemetry Hub Mini: Storyboard + Compact Chart Specs for Per-Model/Route Canvas
creator: Lena Chen
description:
Purpose: define a compact, scannable Telemetry Hub Mini for per-model and per-route performance signals. The goal is a single-row
storyboard card that surfaces latency quantiles, throughput trend, token composition and cost,
batching characteristics, KV-cache hit-rate, and current rollout traffic split — optimized for
dense dashboards and route lists. This ticket captures the interaction storyboard, high-
fidelity chart specs for each micro-widget, acceptance criteria, and prototype links for review.
chart_specs:
Overview: Telemetry Hub Mini is a horizontally compact card composed of 6 micro-widgets:

1) Latency Quantile Stripe (left-most narrow column)
  - Metric: request_latency_ms (p50, p90, p95, p99)
  - Aggregation: percentile over sliding window (default 5m), fallback 15m for low traffic
